blockerDiagnostic.summary: Isolated durable run cannot be initialized safely for standalone Section 2 generation without inventing credentials.
blockerDiagnostic.rootCause: POST /api/v1/autogen/reading-paper/section delegates to facade.generate_section, which requires upstream artifact bootstrapping (SourcePack, EvidenceGraph, ExamBlueprint) via client.grant_operation. CheckpointService.ValidateRunAuthorityAndFencingAsync strictly rejects any runId that is not an existing, leased row in reading_paper_runs (HTTP 404). In the current architecture, ReadingPaperWorker only creates runs as part of a full multi-source job starting at index 1, and benchmark provision requires an existing authorized campaign (0 exist). Therefore, independent Section 2 cannot be initialized without inventing synthetic runs or credentials.
